units.title: Quiero + infinitive, affirmative
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 1, unit 1. Grants the open infinitive slot for vocab verbs; power-verb infinitives are enumerated individually.

units.title: Quiero + infinitive, negative
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 1, unit 2. Applies ambient preverbal 'no' to the opener; adds tampoco ('I don't want to either').

units.title: Puedo + infinitive
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 1, unit 3. Chained to opener.quiero so the infinitive slot and seed verbs flow (MOC lists no prereq; see data README).

units.title: Debo + infinitive
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 1, unit 4. 'I must go / try / wait' — ir enumerated here; intentar/esperar inherited from unit 1.

units.title: Tengo que + infinitive
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 1, unit 5. 'I have to leave / pay / call' — salir inherited from unit 3.

units.title: Voy a + infinitive
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 1, unit 6. 'I'm going to eat / call / leave' — all three verbs inherited along the opener chain.

units.title: Openers interleaved
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 1, unit 7. Pure interleave; grants nothing new. Includes unit 2 so negative items mix in.

units.title: lo / la attached to the infinitive
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 2, unit 8. 'I want to see it / cancel it / find her.' Clitic pronouns ride the construction tag, not vocab (see data README). Hangs off opener.mixed so items range over all five openers.

units.title: los / las attached to the infinitive
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 2, unit 9. 'I'm going to invite them / buy them.'

units.title: me / te / nos attached to the infinitive
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 2, unit 10. 'He wants to visit me / I have to call you' — the MOC drill itself demands 3sg openers, so quiere/puede/tiene enter here.

units.title: Direct-object clitics + openers interleaved
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 2, unit 11. Pure interleave; grants nothing new.

units.title: le / les attached to the infinitive
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 3, unit 12. 'I want to speak to him / give them something.'

units.title: me lo / te lo / nos lo attached to the infinitive
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 3, unit 13. 'He wants to give it to me / sell it to us.' Prereq is unit 12 (MOC says 11) so dar/decir are licensed; see data README.

units.title: le + lo collision → se lo
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 3, unit 14. 'I want to give it to him → quiero dárselo.'

units.title: Two-pronoun structures + openers interleaved
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 3, unit 15. Pure interleave; grants nothing new.

units.title: Yes/no questions (intonation + ¿…?)
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 4, unit 16. 'Do you want to come? Can you wait?' — questions are where tú forms of the five openers enter.

units.title: Wh-questions: qué, quién, dónde, cuándo, cómo, por qué, cuánto
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 4, unit 17. Question words ride the construction tag (function words, see data README).

units.title: Embedded questions after saber
units.note: MOC v2 Phase 4, unit 18. 'I want to know if she wants to come' — needs quiere, so unit 10 is a prereq (MOC says 17 only); see data README.
